name: Falun Mountain
description: Falun, the Valkyries’ sacred city, floats atop the towering peaks of the Maëd Range as a sanctuary closed off to outsiders, and those few invited in find a wondrous sight. The stone structures are carved with sacred symbols in gold while the streets are taken by valkyries sharpening their weapons, writing and singing epic poems, or riding their pegasus in patrols. At the center is the temple dedicated to the spirits, encircled by many communal halls. Here, the valkyries prepare themselves for the ultimate battle against the Ungods while searching for valorous heroes for them to guide. The Valkyries believe that their holy power comes from the poems and legends kept stored in the temple vaults, which hold the essence of the praised heroes. A claim they prove with unaging bodies and holy powers. Their creed stands that on the day of the final battle against the Ungods, the spirit of these legendary individuals will infuse their bodies and allow them to show their true strength. During battles, it is common to see Valkyries soaring in the skies, protecting heroes, or searching for new champions. They often nurture those with great potential, but only those they deem honorable. Those who betray them or lose their honor while being guided are hunted down for being potential servants of the Ungods. While the Valkyries travel the continent searching for individuals to guide, they rarely involve themselves in mortal affairs, preferring to drive people to solve their own problems. However, their honorable and benevolent nature may cause one to intercede, especially if extraplanar forces are involved. Currently, the Valkyries are seeking champions to stop the spread of Bás Temples in the west islands and to venture into the Mystical region to recover lost artifacts in the ruins.
